extract_diffs: extract SEARCH and REPLACE diff blocks from an LLM response string into a list of tuples
apply_diff: apply SEARCH/REPLACE diff patches to source code and return the modified code string
format_diff_summary: format a list of diff blocks into a human-readable summary with inline or block formatting
format_diff_summary_truncation: format diff blocks with configurable max line length and max lines to control truncation
apply_diff_multiple_patches: apply multiple SEARCH/REPLACE diff patches in sequence to transform source code
